content.text: The project currently shows a total value of €0.00, indicating that no financial data has been recorded or allocated. This critical gap prevents accurate cost estimation, budget planning, and resource allocation. Immediate action is required to review the project structure, verify data entry processes, and ensure all line items are correctly linked to the cost center. Without valid financial inputs, risk assessment and progress tracking are compromised. Management must prioritize data integrity checks to establish a reliable baseline for future forecasting and to prevent potential budget overruns or compliance issues.
